sentences.en: For spectroscopic purposes the Cassegrain form has peculiar advantages, because in consequence of the less rapid convergence of the rays after reflection from the convex hyperboloidal mirror, the equivalent focus can be made very great in comparison with the length of the tube.

sentences.en: A subsidiary in Germany, followed by another in Belgium, laid out the brand's European expansion. 1980 marked the date when Phillipe Cassegrain (son of Jean Cassegrain) took over the family business.
